verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a public API reference that covers 'all aspects of the Braintrust platform programmatically': creating and managing projects, experiments and datasets, logging traces and metrics, and managing prompts, tools and scorers. Official SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server sit on top of it for agent-driven use. The failed OpenAPI probe at common paths and one community remark about sparse documentation do not contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the platform through the raw API.
